people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: Yahweh struck the people, because of what they did with the calf, which Aaron made.
translations.bsb: And the LORD sent a plague on the people because of what they had done with the calf that Aaron had made.
translations.kjv: And the LORD plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
translations.asv: And Jehovah smote the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
